queries.sql: SELECT `transaksi`.*, COALESCE(siswa.nama_siswa, siswa2.nama_siswa) AS nama_siswa, COALESCE(siswa.nis, siswa2.nis) AS nis, `guru`.`nama_guru`, `guru`.`nip` FROM `transaksi` LEFT JOIN `pembayaran_spp` ON `transaksi`.`id_pembayaran_spp` = `pembayaran_spp`.`id_pembayaran_spp` LEFT JOIN `siswa` ON `pembayaran_spp`.`id_siswa` = `siswa`.`id_siswa` LEFT JOIN `pembayaran_semester` ON `transaksi`.`id_pembayaran_semester` = `pembayaran_semester`.`id_pembayaran_semester` LEFT JOIN `siswa` AS `siswa2` ON `pembayaran_semester`.`id_siswa` = `siswa2`.`id_siswa` LEFT JOIN `pembayaran_gaji` ON `transaksi`.`id_pembayaran_gaji` = `pembayaran_gaji`.`id_pembayaran_gaji` LEFT JOIN `gaji` ON `pembayaran_gaji`.`id_gaji` = `gaji`.`id_gaji` LEFT JOIN `guru` ON `gaji`.`id_guru` = `guru`.`id_guru` ORDER BY `transaksi`.`tanggal` DESC, `transaksi`.`created_at` DESC
